scope: Tracked source comparison only; no environment file, runtime credential, hash value, remote login, service mutation or deployment access

observations.environmentLoad: src/server.js imports config.js; src/config.js:3 invokes dotenv.config; productionMapIntegration.js:33 calls createMapStaffAuth(authOptions) whose default env is process.env
observations.origin: src/mapStaffAuth.js:46 prefers RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL to MAP_STAFF_ORIGIN; :52 rejects mismatched Origin or cross-site sec-fetch-site; login returns 403 ORIGIN_REJECTED before password verification
observations.argon2: Exact accepted Argon2id parameters and native argon2.verify remain identical to both baselines; generated settings are not newly changed
observations.retry: Per-socket 10/global 30 attempts per 15 minutes, plus single in-flight verification, return 429 LOGIN_RETRY_LATER; Retry-After is a fixed 60 seconds and does not establish limiter expiry
observations.injection: Auth reads process.env directly rather than config.envValue normalization; adding trim/unquoting would change credential semantics and is outside this UI patch
observations.changedUi: public/map-staff-entry.js:70 preserves HTTP status for non-JSON responses; :226 only reports credential rejection for 401 LOGIN_FAILED; origin/service/transport/limiter are separately displayed
observations.limitation: Local error rendering evidence cannot identify the actual Stage response status or prove the real password is accepted
